metadata.short_desc: WhatsApp Web Gateway adapter with QR-code login.
metadata.desc: AstrBot platform adapter for WhatsApp Web/Baileys with QR/phone pairing, DM/group access control, media, streaming replies, and multi-instance support.

gateway_host.hint: Base bind address for the bundled Gateway. Keep 127.0.0.1 when AstrBot and the Gateway share a host/container, and do not expose it directly to the public Internet.

gateway_port.hint: Base HTTP/SSE port used by the default instance. Bundled secondary instances allocate subsequent available ports automatically.

auto_start_gateway.hint: Starts the Node.js Gateway for the login Page and platform runtime. Multi-instance mode isolates ports and auth directories automatically. Disable this when using an external Gateway.

node_executable.hint: Node.js 20+ is recommended, for example node or /usr/bin/node.

auth_dir.hint: Leave empty to use data/plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_whatsapp_adapter/whatsapp-auth. Bundled secondary instances automatically use separate suffixed directories.

log_level.hint: Options: silent, fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace. Restore info after troubleshooting.

default_link_preview_single_url.hint: Shared default for all WhatsApp instances. A preview is generated only when a plain-text message contains exactly one URL.

default_typing_indicator.hint: Shared default for all WhatsApp instances. Concurrent replies coordinate composing presence so one reply does not stop another prematurely.

default_send_read_receipts.hint: Send read receipts for inbound messages that pass access control and are accepted for processing.

default_mark_online.hint: When enabled, keep the account available. When disabled, the adapter may still go online briefly while replying and returns to unavailable afterward.

default_parse_inbound_formatting.hint: Convert WhatsApp bold, italic, strikethrough, and code formatting to Markdown for AstrBot.

default_media_album_debounce_seconds.hint: Wait window for merging a short burst of images from the same sender. Private-chat captions and mentions are preserved where possible. Set 0 to disable.

default_streaming_edit_throttle.hint: Global minimum interval between streaming text edits. Default 1.0 seconds; runtime enforces a minimum of 0.1 seconds.

whatsapp-login.title: WhatsApp Adapter — Management
whatsapp-login.description: View Gateway status, sign in to WhatsApp Web, manage the session, and install verified updates.
whatsapp-login.heading: Management

qr.title: QR code login
qr.scan_hint: On your phone, open WhatsApp → Linked devices and scan the QR code.
qr.connected_hint: No scan is required. Use Log out if you want to switch accounts.
qr.connected_action_hint: To switch accounts, choose Log out and scan again.
qr.refresh_hint: The QR code refreshes periodically. Use the button below if scanning fails.
qr.connection_failed_hint: Could not connect to WhatsApp. Check the network and try again.
qr.retry_hint: Use Retry to create a fresh login session.
qr.pairing_hint: Keep the phone online and do not refresh or scan repeatedly.
qr.connecting_hint: The first startup can take a few seconds before a QR code appears.
qr.login_success_hint: The page will switch to Connected automatically after sign-in.

pairing.divider: Or pair with a phone number
pairing.help: Include the country or region code. The number is used only for this pairing request and is not stored by this page.
pairing.result_title: Enter this pairing code on your phone
pairing.expiry: Pairing codes expire quickly. You can request another after the cooldown. This page clears the code on session reset, restart, or logout.
pairing.invalid_phone: Enter a valid international phone number including the country or region code.
pairing.request_pending: Requesting a pairing code from WhatsApp…
pairing.generated: Pairing code generated. Complete the connection on your phone soon.
pairing.failed: Could not get a pairing code. Check the number and Gateway status, then try again.
pairing.copy_failed: Automatic copy failed. Select and copy the pairing code manually.
